metadata.phase: Phase 5.2 - Event Matching & Latency Consistency Check

root_cause_of_identical_phase5_1_lag_and.issue: Phase 5.1 summary table displayed p50=47.7 ms and p95=132.7 ms for both acoustic response lag (t_lag) and end-to-end latency (t_e2e).
root_cause_of_identical_phase5_1_lag_and.diagnosis: In audit_phase5_1_metrics.py lines 310-317, the summary dictionary acoustic_offset_response_lag was assigned the scalar 47.7 ms from the end-to-end latency variable rather than computing the percentile from lag_latencies.
root_cause_of_identical_phase5_1_lag_and.per_trial_mathematical_relation: In each individual detection, t_lag = (t_det - t_offset) * 1000 and t_e2e = t_lag + t_infer. Since t_infer is ~2.3 ms, t_lag and t_e2e are mathematically distinct in every sample.

root_causes: 1. Measurement Context: The 2.43 ms value was measured in-situ during live audio streaming interleaved with segmenter state updates and buffer allocations; 1.69 ms was measured in a tight synthetic loop.
2. Audio Buffer Content: Computing STFT on all-zero arrays executes faster due to zero-vector SIMD optimizations; real speech audio contains fluctuating floats.
3. Cache Residency: Tight microbenchmarks maintain 100% L1/L2 cache residency; stream processing incurs periodic cache line evictions.

frontend_plus_inference_real_speech.component: Frontend Log-Mel STFT + ONNX Model Inference on Real Speech Buffer

total_end_to_end_latency.component: End-to-End Latency from Syllable Offset to Event Emission (t_e2e = t_lag + t_infer)

event_matching_audit_summary.regression_details: All 6 discrepancies were in legacy_v11. Greedy matching misclassified True Positives as Substitutions due to tie-breaking in delayed speech. Continuous valley and hybrid segmenter had 0 regressions.
